_comment: Benchmark definitions for suite.py.  Edit this file, not the script, to add a case or change a size.  Every benchmark is analytic (no data files), so it runs identically on any machine.
_sizes_note: nx -> 4*nx*nx triangles: S=160k, M=2.0M, L=7.8M, XL=24M.  Any integer is also accepted via --sizes.

gates._comment: Run before any timing.  A failed gate marks the whole run INVALID in the summary.

benchmarks.name: dam
benchmarks.title: Wet dam break (hero)
benchmarks.regime: all cells wet, constant work per step, conservative

benchmarks.name: river
benchmarks.title: Dam break into a dry river valley
benchmarks.regime: reservoir releases into a carved channel; floodplain starts dry, ~20% of cells active

benchmarks.name: beach
benchmarks.title: Tsunami run-up on a headland coast
benchmarks.regime: offshore wave inundates a dry slope; the shoreline (wet/dry front) moves with time

benchmarks.name: river_rain
benchmarks.title: Rain on the river valley
benchmarks.regime: uniform rain wets every cell: the active set's worst case (~100% active, rebuild overhead only)
